examples.english: Last year, the temperature in Taiwan in winter was very low—only five degrees—it was freezing!

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上我發燒，燒到三十九度，那種感覺非常不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ fāshāo, shāo dào sānshíjiǔ dù, nà zhǒng gǎnjué fēicháng bù shūfu.
examples.english: Last night I had a fever that went up to thirty-nine degrees, and that feeling was extremely uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 因為每天跟台灣人練習說話，莫以凡的中文程度越來越好了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi měitiān gēn Táiwān rén liànxí shuōhuà, Mò Yǐfán de Zhōngwén chéngdù yuèláiyuè hǎo le.
examples.english: Because he practices speaking with Taiwanese people every day, Mo Yifan's Chinese level is getting better and better.

examples.chinese: 那位服務生不笑的時候，樣子看起來很兇，其實他對客人的態度很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúwùshēng bù xiào de shíhou, yàngzi kàn qǐlái hěn xiōng, qíshí tā duì kèrén de tàidù hěn hǎo.
examples.english: When that waiter doesn't smile, he looks very fierce, but actually his attitude toward customers is very good.

examples.chinese: 外國學生一開始學寫漢字的速度比較慢，只要多練習就能越寫越快了。
examples.pinyin: Wàiguó xuéshēng yī kāishǐ xué xiě Hànzì de sùdù bǐjiào màn, zhǐyào duō liànxí jiù néng yuè xiě yuè kuài le.
examples.english: Foreign students' speed at writing Chinese characters is relatively slow at first; as long as they practice more, they will be able to write faster and faster.

examples.chinese: 那位大明星身上穿的、手上戴的 ，都是有名的牌子。經理做事態度認真、負責，我從他身上學到了很多做人做事的道理。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi dà míngxīng shēnshang chuān de, shǒushang dài de, dōu shì yǒumíng de páizi. Jīnglǐ zuòshì tàidù rènzhēn, fùzé, wǒ cóng tā shēnshang xué dào le hěn duō zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english: What that big star wears on her body and on her hands are all famous brands. The manager's work attitude is serious and responsible; I have learned many principles of how to conduct myself and do things from him.

examples.chinese: 想要吸引顧客來購買價格高的商品，除了品質好，服務態度也很重要。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎngyào xīyǐn gùkè lái gòumǎi jiàgé gāo de shāngpǐn, chúle pǐnzhì hǎo, fúwù tàidù yě hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: If you want to attract customers to buy high-priced products, in addition to good quality, service attitude is also very important.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳不僅服務態度好，而且食物好吃又便宜，難怪大家都推薦我來嚐嚐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bùjǐn fúwù tàidù hǎo, érqiě shíwù hǎochī yòu piányi, nánguài dàjiā dōu tuījiàn wǒ lái chángchang.
examples.english: This restaurant not only has a good service attitude, but the food is also delicious and cheap; no wonder everyone recommended I come and try it.

examples.chinese: 對不起！我昨天跟你說話的態度不好，我向你道歉，請你別生氣了。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ! Wǒ zuótiān gēn nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù bù hǎo, wǒ xiàng nǐ dàoqiàn, qǐng nǐ bié shēngqì le.
examples.english: I'm sorry! My attitude when talking to you yesterday was not good. I apologize to you; please don't be angry anymore.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文程度，我除了認真上課、寫作業，還每天聽收音機的英文廣播。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù, wǒ chúle rènzhēn shàngkè, xiě zuòyè, hái měi tiān tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō.
examples.english: In order to raise my English level, besides attending class seriously and doing homework, I also listen to English radio broadcasts every day.

examples.chinese: 從明天起天氣會變冷，溫度會比今天降低五度，出門時最好穿上外套。
examples.pinyin: Cóng míngtiān qǐ tiānqì huì biàn lěng, wēndù huì bǐ jīntiān jiàngdī wǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo chuān shàng wàitào.
examples.english: Starting tomorrow, the weather will turn cold; the temperature will drop five degrees compared to today, so it's best to put on a jacket when going out.

examples.chinese: 大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。
examples.pinyin: Dàbǎo míngnián yǒu qù Yīngguó liúxué de dǎsuàn, suǒyǐ zhǎo le jiātíng jiàoshī bāng tā bǔxí, xīwàng tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù.
examples.english: Dabao plans to study abroad in the UK next year, so he found a private tutor to help him with cram tutoring, hoping to improve his English level.

examples.chinese: 父母做人做事的態度，對孩子會產生極大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi huì chǎnshēng jí dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents' attitudes toward how they conduct themselves and handle matters will produce a tremendous influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報說，從明天起一連三天，中部以北地氣溫只有十五度，出門時最好加件外套。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō, cóng míngtiān qǐ yīlián sān tiān, zhōngbù yǐběi dìqū qìwēn zhǐyǒu shíwǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo jiā jiàn wàitào.
examples.english: The weather forecast says that starting tomorrow for three days in a row, the temperature in the central and northern regions will be only 15 degrees; when going out, it's best to add a jacket.

examples.chinese: 參加籃球社的條件是跑步的速度得夠快，但是沒有身高的限制。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā lánqiú shè de tiáojiàn shì pǎobù de sùdù děi gòu kuài, dànshì méiyǒu shēngāo de xiànzhì.
examples.english: The condition for joining the basketball club is that your running speed must be fast enough, but there is no height restriction.

examples.chinese: 他做事的態度很差，而且一不高興就罵人，誰受得了這種人啊！
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì de tàidù hěn chà, érqiě yí bù gāoxìng jiù mà rén, shéi shòu de liǎo zhè zhǒng rén a!
examples.english: His attitude toward work is very bad, and whenever he is unhappy he scolds people; who can tolerate this kind of person!

examples.chinese: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn. Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english: If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test. In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 我同學記筆記的速度很快，也記得很清楚，所以我常跟他借筆記來複習功課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué jì bǐjì de sùdù hěn kuài, yě jì de hěn qīngchu, suǒyǐ wǒ cháng gēn tā jiè bǐjì lái fùxí gōngkè.
examples.english: My classmate takes notes very quickly and also remembers them very clearly, so I often borrow his notes to review my lessons.

examples.chinese: 黃先生上班常遲到，也不認真工作，這樣的態度讓老闆很不滿。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng shàngbān cháng chídào, yě bù rènzhēn gōngzuò, zhèyàng de tàidù ràng lǎobǎn hěn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang is often late for work and does not work seriously; this kind of attitude makes the boss very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 為了提供學生良好的學習環境，學校改善了教室的設備，網路的速度也變快了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígōng xuéshēng liánghǎo de xuéxí huánjìng, xuéxiào gǎishàn le jiàoshì de shèbèi, wǎnglù de sùdù yě biàn kuài le.
examples.english: In order to provide students with a good learning environment, the school improved the classroom equipment, and the internet speed also became faster.

examples.chinese: 父母是孩子的榜樣，他們的性格和做人做事的態度，對孩子都有很大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì háizi de bǎngyàng, tāmen de xìnggé hé zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi dōu yǒu hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents are their children's role models; their personality and their attitude toward how to conduct themselves and do things both have a great influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 只要你堅持每天學習一個小時的中文，我保證你的程度一定會越來越好的。石先生對自己的想法很堅持，從不接受別人的意見，所以很難相處。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén, wǒ bǎozhèng nǐ de chéngdù yídìng huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de. Shí xiānsheng duì zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiānchí, cóng bù jiēshòu biérén de yìjiàn, suǒyǐ hěn nán xiāngchǔ.
examples.english: As long as you insist on studying Chinese for one hour every day, I guarantee your level will definitely get better and better. Mr. Shi is very insistent on his own ideas and never accepts others' opinions, so he is hard to get along with.

examples.chinese: 這個保養品很適合皮膚乾的人，所以秋冬兩個季節銷售得非常好。因為店員的服務態度很好，所以這個專櫃的銷售成績是最好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bǎoyǎngpǐn hěn shìhé pífū gān de rén, suǒyǐ qiū dōng liǎng ge jìjié xiāoshòu de fēicháng hǎo. Yīnwèi diànyuán de fúwù tàidù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhège zhuān guì de xiāoshòu chéngjì shì zuì hǎo de.
examples.english: This skincare product is very suitable for people with dry skin, so its sales in the autumn and winter seasons are very good. Because the staff's service attitude is very good, this counter's sales performance is the best.

examples.chinese: 何老闆替公司建立了良好的制度，讓員工都能安心地工作。
examples.pinyin: Hé lǎobǎn tì gōngsī jiànlì le liánghǎo de zhìdù, ràng yuángōng dōu néng ānxīn de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Boss He established a good system for the company, allowing employees to work with peace of mind.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠自從改善了設備以後，生產速度就一天比一天快了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng zìcóng gǎishàn le shèbèi yǐhòu, shēngchǎn sùdù jiù yī tiān bǐ yī tiān kuài le.
examples.english: Ever since that factory improved its equipment, its production speed has become faster day by day.

examples.chinese: 他最近對你說話的態度變得冷淡，你們之間是不是有什麼誤會？
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn duì nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù biàn de lěngdàn, nǐmen zhījiān shì bùshì yǒu shénme wùhuì?
examples.english: His attitude when speaking to you has recently become cold; is there some misunderstanding between you two?

examples.chinese: 出國留學有不少好處，例如打開視野、增加自信、提高外文程度等等。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué yǒu bùshǎo hǎochù, lìrú dǎkāi shìyě, zēngjiā zìxìn, tígāo wàiwén chéngdù děngděng.
examples.english: Studying abroad has many benefits, for example, broadening one's horizons, increasing self-confidence, improving foreign language proficiency, and so on.

examples.chinese: 那個店員的工作態度很隨便，常弄錯商品的價格，還找錯錢， 真是太誇張了！
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán de gōngzuò tàidù hěn suíbiàn, cháng nòngcuò shāngpǐn de jiàgé, hái zhǎo cuò qián, zhēn shì tài kuāzhāng le!
examples.english: That clerk's work attitude is very careless; he often gets the product prices wrong and also gives the wrong change—that's really too outrageous!

examples.chinese: 現在的電腦處理資料的速度比以往快得多，功能也更多了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de diànnǎo chǔlǐ zīliào de sùdù bǐ yǐwǎng kuài de duō, gōngnéng yě gèng duō le.
examples.english: Today's computers process data much faster than in the past, and have more functions.

examples.chinese: 面試時必須穿正式的服裝，跟老闆對話時，也應表現出客氣、 謙虛的態度。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì shí bìxū chuān zhèngshì de fúzhuāng, gēn lǎobǎn duìhuà shí, yě yīng biǎoxiàn chū kèqì, qiānxū de tàidù.
examples.english: During an interview, you must wear formal clothing; when speaking with the boss, you should also show a polite and modest attitude.

examples.chinese: 古小姐做事的態度很積極，為了完成任務，總是很早就做好計畫，而且立刻實行。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiǎojiě zuòshì de tàidù hěn jījí, wèile wánchéng rènwù, zǒngshì hěn zǎo jiù zuò hǎo jìhuà, érqiě lìkè shíxíng.
examples.english: Miss Gu has a very proactive attitude toward work. In order to complete tasks, she always makes plans early and immediately carries them out.

examples.chinese: 由於每個人看事情的角度不同，所以得溝通才能避免誤會。那個模特兒個子高、長得美，從什麼角度拍都漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú měi gè rén kàn shìqíng de jiǎodù bùtóng, suǒyǐ děi gōutōng cái néng bìmiǎn wùhuì. Nàge mótè'ér gèzi gāo, zhǎng de měi, cóng shénme jiǎodù pāi dōu piàoliang.
examples.english: Because each person's point of view on things is different, communication is necessary to avoid misunderstandings. That model is tall and beautiful; from whatever angle you photograph her, she looks pretty.

examples.chinese: 到新公司報到以前，應先把個人的態度及觀念調整好。
examples.pinyin: Dào xīn gōngsī bàodào yǐqián, yīng xiān bǎ gèrén de tàidù jí guānniàn tiáozhěng hǎo.
examples.english: Before reporting for duty at a new company, you should first adjust your personal attitude and mindset well.

examples.chinese: 現在的電腦晶片速度越來越快，功能也越來越多了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de diànnǎo jīngpiàn sùdù yuè lái yuè kuài, gōngnéng yě yuè lái yuè duō le.
examples.english: Today's computer chips are getting faster and faster in speed, and their functions are also becoming more and more numerous.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
examples.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

examples.chinese: 我們無法決定生命的長度，卻能夠決定生活的品質。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ juédìng shēngmìng de chángdù, què nénggòu juédìng shēnghuó de pǐnzhì.
examples.english: We cannot decide the length of life, but we can decide the quality of life.

examples.chinese: 你穿的這件衣服肩膀寬度很合適，就是長度太長了，要是能改短一些就好了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ chuān de zhè jiàn yīfu jiānbǎng kuāndù hěn héshì, jiùshì chángdù tài cháng le, yàoshì néng gǎi duǎn yīxiē jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: The shoulder width of this piece of clothing you're wearing is very suitable; it's just that the length is too long. If only it could be shortened a bit, that would be good.

examples.chinese: 這座橋對車子的高度有限制，開大車的人要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo duì chēzi de gāodù yǒu xiànzhì, kāi dàchē de rén yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This bridge has a height restriction for vehicles; those driving large vehicles should be careful.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的超商有店到店的送貨服務，不但速度快，運費也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de chāoshāng yǒu diàn dào diàn de sònghuò fúwù, bùdàn sùdù kuài, yùnfèi yě bù guì.
examples.english: Convenience stores in Taiwan offer store-to-store delivery service; not only is it fast, but the shipping fee is also inexpensive.

examples.chinese: 跟朋友飲酒是一件開心的事，不過飲酒過度卻可能傷害身體。
examples.pinyin: Gēn péngyǒu yǐn jiǔ shì yí jiàn kāixīn de shì, búguò yǐn jiǔ guòdù què kěnéng shānghài shēntǐ.
examples.english: Drinking alcohol with friends is a happy thing, but excessive drinking may harm your health.

examples.chinese: 今天氣溫只有零下(below zero)三度，我家沒暖氣，不管穿多厚的衣服，全身還是冰冰的。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān qìwēn zhǐyǒu língxià sān dù, wǒ jiā méi nuǎnqì, bùguǎn chuān duō hòu de yīfu, quánshēn háishì bīngbīng de.
examples.english: Today the temperature is only three degrees below zero. My home has no heater, and no matter how thick the clothes I wear, my whole body still feels icy cold.

examples.chinese: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuì zhǔyào de rènwu yīng shì wéichí bìng bǎohù shèhuì ānquán, qícì shì guīhuà gè zhǒng zhìdù, shǐ guójiā wěndìng de chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The government's most main task should be to maintain and protect social security; next is to plan various systems so that the country can grow stably.

examples.chinese: 過度消費及使用塑膠材料的產品，都會增加自然環境的負擔。
examples.pinyin: Guòdù xiāofèi jí shǐyòng sùjiāo cáiliào de chǎnpǐn, dōu huì zēngjiā zìrán huánjìng de fùdān.
examples.english: Excessive consumption and the use of plastic material products will both increase the burden on the natural environment.

examples.chinese: 冷氣的溫度要是控制得剛好，不但對健康好，也能省點兒電費。
examples.pinyin: Lěngqì de wēndù yàoshi kòngzhì de gānghǎo, bùdàn duì jiànkāng hǎo, yě néng shěng diǎnr diànfèi.
examples.english: If the air conditioner's temperature is controlled to be just right, it is not only good for health but also saves a bit on electricity bills.

examples.chinese: 下過雨後道路比較滑，開車時速度別太快。
examples.pinyin: Xià guò yǔ hòu dàolù bǐjiào huá, kāichē shí sùdù bié tài kuài.
examples.english: After it has rained, the road is rather slippery; when driving, don't go too fast.

examples.chinese: 根據目前科學研究的資料，女性與男性在能力、態度和行為等方面的差異都非常小。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù mùqián kēxué yánjiū de zīliào, nǚxìng yǔ nánxìng zài nénglì, tàidù hé xíngwéi děng fāngmiàn de chāyì dōu fēicháng xiǎo.
examples.english: According to current scientific research data, the differences between women and men in aspects such as ability, attitude, and behavior are all very small.

examples.chinese: 以前學校規定女學生的髮型都要一樣，而且長度不能超過耳朵。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián xuéxiào guīdìng nǚ xuéshēng de fàxíng dōu yào yīyàng, érqiě chángdù bùnéng chāoguò ěrduo.
examples.english: In the past, the school required that female students' hairstyles all be the same, and the length could not exceed the ears.

examples.chinese: 在處理那位顧客的問題上，餐廳的態度真令我失望。
examples.pinyin: Zài chǔlǐ nà wèi gùkè de wèntí shàng, cāntīng de tàidù zhēn lìng wǒ shīwàng.
examples.english: In handling that customer's problem, the restaurant's attitude really disappointed me.

examples.chinese: 水和冰基本上是相同的，只是因溫度而產生不同的變化。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ hé bīng jīběnshàng shì xiāngtóng de, zhǐshì yīn wēndù ér chǎnshēng bùtóng de biànhuà.
examples.english: Water and ice are basically the same; they just undergo different changes due to temperature.

examples.chinese: 自動化工廠不僅使生產速度更快，同時也能保證產品品質。
examples.pinyin: Zìdònghuà gōngchǎng bùjǐn shǐ shēngchǎn sùdù gèng kuài, tóngshí yě néng bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn pǐnzhí.
examples.english: Automated factories not only make production speed faster but also can guarantee product quality.

examples.chinese: 都市人口如果過度成長，容易引發環保及交通問題。
examples.pinyin: Dūshì rénkǒu rúguǒ guòdù chéngzhǎng, róngyì yǐnfā huánbǎo jí jiāotōng wèntí.
examples.english: If urban population grows excessively, it easily leads to environmental and traffic problems.

examples.chinese: 用人類的角度去看大自然， 就看不出大自然的本來價值。
examples.pinyin: Yòng rénlèi de jiǎodù qù kàn dàzìrán, jiù kàn bù chū dàzìrán de běnlái jiàzhí.
examples.english: Looking at nature from a human perspective, you cannot see nature's original value.

examples.chinese: 使用高度技術製造出來的工業生產機器，操作起來往往更有效率。
examples.pinyin: Shǐyòng gāodù jìshù zhìzào chūlái de gōngyè shēngchǎn jīqì, cāozuò qǐlái wǎngwǎng gèng yǒu xiàolǜ.
examples.english: Industrial production machines manufactured using highly advanced technology often operate more efficiently.

examples.chinese: 他想等中文程度達到高級以後，就來臺灣念大學。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng děng Zhōngwén chéngdù dádào gāojí yǐhòu, jiù lái Táiwān niàn dàxué.
examples.english: He wants to wait until his Chinese proficiency reaches the advanced level, and then come to Taiwan to attend university.

examples.chinese: 妹妹個子比較高，手也長， 買衣服時都得注意袖子的長度。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei gèzi bǐjiào gāo, shǒu yě cháng, mǎi yīfu shí dōu děi zhùyì xiùzi de chángdù.
examples.english: My younger sister is relatively tall and has long arms, so when buying clothes she always has to pay attention to the sleeve length.

examples.chinese: 學校的畢業典禮辦得很精彩，讓我們度過了愉快的一天。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de bìyè diǎnlǐ bàn de hěn jīngcǎi, ràng wǒmen dùguò le yúkuài de yī tiān.
examples.english: The school's graduation ceremony was held wonderfully, allowing us to spend a happy day.

examples.chinese: 春假時我打算到泰國小島上的鄉村去度個假。
examples.pinyin: Chūnjià shí wǒ dǎsuàn dào Tàiguó xiǎodǎo shàng de xiāngcūn qù dù gè jià.
examples.english: During spring break, I plan to go to a village on a small island in Thailand to spend a vacation.

examples.chinese: 妳身高一百七十公分，體重六十公斤，還不到減肥的程度。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shēngāo yībǎi qīshí gōngfēn, tǐzhòng liùshí gōngjīn, hái bù dào jiǎnféi de chéngdù.
examples.english: You are 170 cm tall and weigh 60 kg; you are not yet at the level where you need to lose weight.

examples.chinese: 當室內與戶外溫度的差別很大時，我就容易感冒。
examples.pinyin: Dāng shìnèi yǔ hùwài wēndù de chābié hěn dà shí, wǒ jiù róngyì gǎnmào.
examples.english: When the difference between indoor and outdoor temperatures is large, I easily catch a cold.

examples.chinese: 保存食物的方式會影響食物的新鮮程度。
examples.pinyin: Bǎocún shíwù de fāngshì huì yǐngxiǎng shíwù de xīnxiān chéngdù.
examples.english: The way of preserving food will affect the freshness of the food.

examples.chinese: 如果想捐頭髮，長度至少要十五公分以上才能捐。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng juān tóufa, chángdù zhìshǎo yào shíwǔ gōngfēn yǐshàng cái néng juān.
examples.english: If you want to donate hair, the length must be at least fifteen centimeters or more to be able to donate.

examples.chinese: 雖然他已經親自說了對不起，但還是很後悔做出那樣沒禮貌的行為，於是再度向各位道歉。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā yǐjīng qīnzì shuō le duìbuqǐ, dàn háishì hěn hòuhuǐ zuòchū nàyàng méi lǐmào de xíngwéi, yúshì zàidù xiàng gèwèi dàoqiàn.
examples.english: Although he has already personally said sorry, he still very much regrets having behaved so impolitely, so he once again apologizes to everyone.

examples.chinese: 對任何人的態度，不該因種族、國籍或性別而不同。
examples.pinyin: Duì rènhé rén de tàidù, bù gāi yīn zhǒngzú, guójí huò xìngbié ér bùtóng.
examples.english: One's attitude toward anyone should not differ because of race, nationality, or gender.

items.wordHook: A 广(building) has twenty 廿(twenty) marks from a 又(right hand); each mark is a 度(degree).

examples.chinese: 日本在台灣的東北方；台灣在中國的東南方。
examples.pinyin: Rìběn zài Táiwān de dōngběifāng; Táiwān zài Zhōngguó de dōngnánfāng.
examples.english: Japan is to the northeast of Taiwan; Taiwan is to the southeast of China.

examples.chinese: 日本在台灣的東北方；台灣在中國的東南方。
examples.pinyin: Rìběn zài Táiwān de dōngběifāng; Táiwān zài Zhōngguó de dōngnánfāng.
examples.english: Japan is to the northeast of Taiwan; Taiwan is to the southeast of China.

examples.chinese: 參加這次總統選舉的人實力都不錯，最後是陳先生當選了。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā zhè cì zǒngtǒng xuǎnjǔ de rén shílì dōu bùcuò, zuìhòu shì Chén xiānsheng dāngxuǎn le.
examples.english: The people who participated in this presidential election all had good qualifications; in the end, Mr. Chen was elected.

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

items.wordHook: Proving that one's 實(real) preparation translates into genuine competitive 力(strength): 實力 means strength.

examples.chinese: 我不認為地攤沒好貨，有一些地攤的東西不僅價格便宜，品質也不錯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú rènwéi dìtān méi hǎohuò, yǒu yìxiē dìtān de dōngxi bùjǐn jiàgé piányi, pǐnzhì yě búcuò.
examples.english: I don't think street stalls have no good goods; some stall items are not only cheap in price, but the quality is also not bad.

examples.chinese: 那位客人在地攤買東西揀來揀去，最後又不買，難怪老闆滿臉不高興的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi kèrén zài dìtān mǎi dōngxi jiǎn lái jiǎn qù, zuìhòu yòu bù mǎi, nánguài lǎobǎn mǎn liǎn bù gāoxìng de yàngzi.
examples.english: That customer kept picking and choosing while shopping at the street stall, and in the end didn’t buy anything; no wonder the owner looked unhappy.

examples.chinese: 我去參加朋友的婚禮，除了送紅包，還祝福他們事事如意、早生貴子、永遠幸福。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù cānjiā péngyou de hūnlǐ, chúle sòng hóngbāo, hái zhùfú tāmen shìshì rúyì, zǎo shēng guìzǐ, yǒngyuǎn xìngfú.
examples.english: I went to attend a friend's wedding; besides giving a red envelope, I also wished them that everything goes as they wish, that they soon have a child, and that they be happy forever.

examples.chinese: 再過幾天就要過年了，在此願大家新年平安，事事如意。
examples.pinyin: Zài guò jǐ tiān jiù yào guònián le, zài cǐ yuàn dàjiā xīnnián píng'ān, shìshì rúyì.
examples.english: In a few days it will be Chinese New Year; here I wish everyone a peaceful new year and that everything goes as you wish.

items.wordHook: May every single 事(affair) turn out 如(if) desired in your 意(thought): 事事如意 means may everything go smoothly.

examples.chinese: 背包客為了解省交通費，經常搭別人的車到下一個地點。
examples.pinyin: Bèibāokè wèile jiéshěng jiāotōng fèi, jīngcháng dā biérén de chē dào xià yí ge dìdiǎn.
examples.english: In order to save on transportation costs, backpackers often hitch rides in other people's cars to the next place.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 我想出國當背包客，除了能打開視野，並能訓練自己更獨立。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chūguó dāng bēibāokè, chúle néng dǎkāi shìyě, bìng néng xùnliàn zìjǐ gèng dúlì.
examples.english: I want to go abroad as a backpacker; besides being able to broaden my horizons, and also train myself to be more independent.

items.wordHook: An independent traveler who carries a 背(back) pack 包(pack) as an adventurous 客(guest): 背包客 means backpacker.

examples.chinese: 這次數學考試的題目似乎難了點，因為超過三分之二的學生考不及格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué kǎoshì de tímù sìhū nán le diǎn, yīnwèi chāoguò sān fēn zhī èr de xuéshēng kǎo bù jígé.
examples.english: The questions on this math exam seem a bit difficult, because more than two-thirds of the students failed.

items.wordHook: Combining 似(resembling) and 乎(interrogative or exclamatory final particle): 似乎 means seemingly.

examples.chinese: 每個人心中都有理想的交友條件，比如年齡幾歲以下，身高幾公分以上，但我只要對方愛我就好了。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén xīnzhōng dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng de jiāoyǒu tiáojiàn, bǐrú niánlíng jǐ suì yǐxià, shēngāo jǐ gōngfēn yǐshàng, dàn wǒ zhǐyào duìfāng ài wǒ jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: Everyone has ideal conditions for making friends in their heart, such as age below a certain number of years old, height above a certain number of centimeters, but for me, as long as the other person loves me, that's enough.

examples.chinese: 有一些交友網站上的個人姓名、年齡等資料都是假的，所以上網交友要小心。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē jiāoyǒu wǎngzhàn shàng de gèrén xìngmíng, niánlíng děng zīliào dōu shì jiǎ de, suǒyǐ shàngwǎng jiāoyǒu yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: Some personal information such as names and ages on dating websites is false, so you need to be careful when making friends online.

examples.chinese: A:你知道辦理留學的手續需要準備哪些資料嗎？ B:我不清楚。你可以上網查查。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zhīdào bànlǐ liúxué de shǒuxù xūyào zhǔnbèi nǎxiē zīliào ma? B: Wǒ bù qīngchu. Nǐ kěyǐ shàngwǎng cháchá.
examples.english: A: Do you know what materials need to be prepared to deal with the procedures for studying abroad? B: I'm not sure. You can look it up online.

examples.chinese: 如果想得到獎學金，必須達成每科成績八十五分以上的要求。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dédào jiǎngxuéjīn, bìxū dáchéng měi kē chéngjì bāshíwǔ fēn yǐshàng de yāoqiú.
examples.english: If you want to get the scholarship, you must fulfill the requirement of a score of eighty-five or above in every subject.

examples.chinese: 你打電話給我的時候，我在睡覺，還沒起來。妹妹昨天太晚睡，今天起不來，所以上課遲到了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ de shíhou, wǒ zài shuìjiào, hái méi qǐlái. Mèimei zuótiān tài wǎn shuì, jīntiān qǐ bù lái, suǒyǐ shàngkè chídào le.
examples.english: When you called me, I was sleeping and hadn't gotten up yet. My younger sister went to bed too late yesterday and couldn't get up today, so she was late for class.

examples.chinese: 在這家咖啡廳，可以上網還可以看雜誌。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā kāfēitīng, kěyǐ shàngwǎng hái kěyǐ kàn zázhì.
examples.english: At this café, you can go online and also read magazines.

examples.chinese: 要是你想建議公司採購新設備，可以上網填採購單。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng jiànyì gōngsī cǎigòu xīn shèbèi, kěyǐ shàngwǎng tián cǎigòu dān.
examples.english: If you want to suggest that the company purchase new equipment, you can fill out a purchase form online.

examples.chinese: 根據手機公司的分析，明年大尺寸手機的市場需求會提高五倍以上。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù shǒujī gōngsī de fēnxī, míngnián dà chǐcùn shǒujī de shìchǎng xūqiú huì tígāo wǔ bèi yǐshàng.
examples.english: According to the cell phone company's analysis, next year the market demand for large-size cell phones will increase by more than five times.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，目前已被發現的蝴蝶大約有三百七十種以上。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, mùqián yǐ bèi fāxiàn de húdié dàyuē yǒu sānbǎi qīshí zhǒng yǐshàng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, the butterflies that have been discovered so far number approximately over 370 species.

examples.chinese: 如果想捐頭髮，長度至少要十五公分以上才能捐。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng juān tóufa, chángdù zhìshǎo yào shíwǔ gōngfēn yǐshàng cái néng juān.
examples.english: If you want to donate hair, the length must be at least fifteen centimeters or more to be able to donate.

items.wordHook: Combining 以(according to) and 上(above): 以上 means above.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 小明順利通過了大學考試，今年就是一年級的新生了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shùnlì tōngguò le dàxué kǎoshì, jīnnián jiù shì yī niánjí de xīnshēng le.
examples.english: Xiaoming successfully passed the university exam; this year he is a freshman.

examples.chinese: 小藍從小在育幼院長大，最大的願望就是將來能有一個溫暖的家庭。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lán cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, zuì dà de yuànwàng jiùshì jiānglái néng yǒu yī gè wēnnuǎn de jiātíng.
examples.english: Xiao Lan grew up in an orphanage; her greatest wish is to have a warm family in the future.

examples.chinese: 李小姐結婚以後的生活重心就是家庭，尤其是照顧剛出生的小孩。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě jiéhūn yǐhòu de shēnghuó zhòngxīn jiùshì jiātíng, yóuqí shì zhàogù gāng chūshēng de xiǎohái.
examples.english: After Miss Li got married, the focus of her life is her family, especially taking care of her newborn child.

examples.chinese: 對爺爺來說，所謂的「好孩子」，就是很孝順、有禮貌、功課好的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Duì yéye lái shuō, suǒwèi de "hǎo háizi", jiùshì hěn xiàoshùn, yǒu lǐmào, gōngkè hǎo de háizi.
examples.english: To Grandpa, a so-called "good child" is a child who is very filial, polite, and does well in school.

examples.chinese: 有人說，男人的話題常跟政治有關，女人的話題不是名牌包、就是化妝品。你同意嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, nánrén de huàtí cháng gēn zhèngzhì yǒuguān, nǚrén de huàtí bùshì míngpái bāo, jiùshì huàzhuāngpǐn. Nǐ tóngyì ma?
examples.english: Some people say that men's topics are often related to politics, and women's topics are either designer bags or cosmetics. Do you agree?

examples.chinese: 我奶奶不會用電腦，每次想跟朋友連絡，不是去郵局寄信就是打家裡的電話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bú huì yòng diànnǎo, měi cì xiǎng gēn péngyǒu liánluò, bú shì qù yóujú jì xìn jiù shì dǎ jiālǐ de diànhuà.
examples.english: My grandmother doesn't know how to use a computer. Every time she wants to contact her friends, she either goes to the post office to mail a letter or calls the home phone.

examples.chinese: 我在山上工作，手機的訊號很弱，朋友常抱怨我的電話不是打不通，就是聲音不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài shānshàng gōngzuò, shǒujī de xìnhào hěn ruò, péngyǒu cháng bàoyuàn wǒ de diànhuà bú shì dǎ bù tōng, jiù shì shēngyīn bù qīngchu.
examples.english: I work in the mountains, and the cell phone signal is very weak. My friends often complain that my phone either can't be reached or the voice is unclear.

examples.chinese: 這個地區被颱風破壞得相當嚴重，不是樹木倒了，就是屋頂被吹走了，情況非常糟糕。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bèi táifēng pòhuài de xiāngdāng yánzhòng, bùshì shùmù dǎo le, jiùshì wūdǐng bèi chuī zǒu le, qíngkuàng fēicháng zāogāo.
examples.english: This area was damaged quite severely by the typhoon; either trees fell down or roofs were blown away—the situation is very bad.

examples.chinese: 小陳很孝順，每個週末都去安養院陪父親聊天、散步，一點兒都不覺得辛苦。孝順父母的方法很多，最簡單的就是不讓他們擔心、生氣。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Chén hěn xiàoshùn, měi gè zhōumò dōu qù ānyǎngyuàn péi fùqīn liáotiān, sànbù, yīdiǎnr dōu bù juéde xīnkǔ. Xiàoshùn fùmǔ de fāngfǎ hěn duō, zuì jiǎndān de jiùshì bù ràng tāmen dānxīn, shēngqì.
examples.english: Xiao Chen is very filial; every weekend he goes to the nursing home to chat and take walks with his father, and doesn't feel the least bit tired. There are many ways to be filial to parents; the simplest is to not make them worry or get angry.

examples.chinese: 這兩部筆電的功能差異不大，就是價錢差了幾百塊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng bù bǐdiàn de gōngnéng chāyì bú dà, jiùshì jiàqián chà le jǐ bǎi kuài.
examples.english: The functional difference between these two laptops is not big; it's just that the price differs by a few hundred dollars.

examples.chinese: 小藍什麼都不怕，就是怕跟女生說話，只要一說話，他的臉就紅了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolán shénme dōu bú pà, jiùshì pà gēn nǚshēng shuōhuà, zhǐyào yì shuōhuà, tā de liǎn jiù hóng le.
examples.english: Xiaolan is not afraid of anything; he is exactly afraid of talking to girls. As soon as he talks, his face turns red.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，冬天的樂趣就是戴著厚厚的手套，和朋友玩雪球。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, dōngtiān de lèqù jiùshì dài zhe hòu hòu de shǒutào, hé péngyǒu wán xuěqiú.
examples.english: For me, the joy of winter is wearing thick gloves and playing snowballs with friends.

examples.chinese: 追求學問就是要多用腦，不斷地學，不斷地問。
examples.pinyin: Zhuīqiú xuéwèn jiùshì yào duō yòng nǎo, bùduàn de xué, bùduàn de wèn.
examples.english: Pursuing learning means using your brain more, constantly learning, and constantly asking questions.

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 「年」是一隻極可怕、會吃人的怪獸，也就是「年獸」。
examples.pinyin: “Nián” shì yì zhī jí kěpà, huì chī rén de guàishòu, yě jiùshì “niánshòu”.
examples.english: 'Nian' is an extremely scary man-eating monster, also known as the 'Nian monster'.

examples.chinese: 護理師的工作就是幫助醫生處理病人的問題。
examples.pinyin: Hùlǐshī de gōngzuò jiùshì bāngzhù yīshēng chǔlǐ bìngrén de wèntí.
examples.english: A nurse's job is to help doctors deal with patients' problems.

examples.chinese: 這家民宿的旁邊就是美麗的海邊，風景美極了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù de pángbiān jiù shì měilì de hǎibiān, fēngjǐng měi jí le.
examples.english: Right next to this guesthouse is a beautiful beach; the scenery is extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 這家民宿的旁邊就是美麗的海邊，風景美極了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù de pángbiān jiù shì měilì de hǎibiān, fēngjǐng měi jí le.
examples.english: Right next to this guesthouse is a beautiful beach; the scenery is extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 易先生對戲劇有很大的興趣，小時候的夢想就是當一名成功的演員。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng duì xìjù yǒu hěn dà de xìngqù, xiǎoshíhou de mèngxiǎng jiùshì dāng yì míng chénggōng de yǎnyuán.
examples.english: Mr. Yi has a great interest in drama; his childhood dream was to become a successful actor.

examples.chinese: (1) 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.
examples.english: Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more.

examples.chinese: 小年的夢想就是蓋一棟土地面積六十坪、三層樓高的房子，讓全家人都住在一起。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎonián de mèngxiǎng jiùshì gài yí dòng tǔdì miànjī liùshí píng, sān céng lóu gāo de fángzi, ràng quánjiā rén dōu zhù zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: Xiao Nian's dream is to build a three-story house with a land area of sixty ping, so that the whole family can live together.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 想要身體健康，最有效的方法就是多運動、少吃甜點、多吃蔬菜水果。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, zuì yǒuxiào de fāngfǎ jiùshì duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tiándiǎn, duō chī shūcài shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, the most effective way is to exercise more, eat fewer sweets, and eat more vegetables and fruit.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，幸福就是在身邊有一群願意互相幫助的好友。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, xìngfú jiùshì zài shēnbiān yǒu yī qún yuànyì hùxiāng bāngzhù de hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: To me, happiness is having a group of good friends around who are willing to help each other.

examples.chinese: 父母對孩子表現的肯定，就是給孩子最好的鼓勵。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ duì háizi biǎoxiàn de kěndìng, jiùshì gěi háizi zuì hǎo de gǔlì.
examples.english: Parents' affirmation of their children's performance is the best encouragement for the children.

examples.chinese: A:哎，有沒有看見我的錢包？ B:哎，你怎麼又在找東西了呢？ A:哎，年紀大了就是這樣？ B:哎，你還年輕呢！讓我幫你一起找吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Āi, yǒu méiyǒu kànjiàn wǒ de qiánbāo? B: Āi, nǐ zěnme yòu zài zhǎo dōngxi le ne? A: Āi, niánjì dà le jiùshì zhèyàng? B: Āi, nǐ hái niánqīng ne! Ràng wǒ bāng nǐ yīqǐ zhǎo ba.
examples.english: A: Hey, have you seen my wallet? B: Hey, how come you're looking for things again? A: Hey, that's just how it is when you get old, I guess? B: Hey, you're still young! Let me help you look for it together.

examples.chinese: 假如東西買回家後常擺著不用，那樣的消費就是不必要的。在開心消費前應先想想，那些商品是不是需要的。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú dōngxī mǎi huí jiā hòu cháng bǎi zhe bù yòng, nàyàng de xiāofèi jiù shì bù bìyào de. Zài kāixīn xiāofèi qián yīng xiān xiǎngxiang, nàxiē shāngpǐn shì bu shì xūyào de.
examples.english: If things are often left unused after being bought and brought home, that kind of consumption is unnecessary. Before happily consuming, you should first think about whether those products are needed.

examples.chinese: 你穿的這件衣服肩膀寬度很合適，就是長度太長了，要是能改短一些就好了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ chuān de zhè jiàn yīfu jiānbǎng kuāndù hěn héshì, jiùshì chángdù tài cháng le, yàoshì néng gǎi duǎn yīxiē jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: The shoulder width of this piece of clothing you're wearing is very suitable; it's just that the length is too long. If only it could be shortened a bit, that would be good.

examples.chinese: 茶食就是喝茶時配著吃的點心、小吃。「茶點」的意思有三種，包含：「茶食」、「茶和點心」、「用茶做的點心」。
examples.pinyin: Cháshí jiùshì hē chá shí pèi zhe chī de diǎnxīn, xiǎochī. “Chádiǎn” de yìsi yǒu sān zhǒng, bāohán: “cháshí”, “chá hé diǎnxīn”, “yòng chá zuò de diǎnxīn”.
examples.english: Tea snacks are the dim sum and small eats that accompany tea when drinking. The term “tea snacks” has three meanings, including: “tea snacks,” “tea and dim sum,” and “dim sum made with tea.”

examples.chinese: 談戀愛時不能太花心，(也)就是說不能見一個就愛一個。
examples.pinyin: Tán liàn'ài shí bùnéng tài huāxīn, (yě) jiùshì shuō bùnéng jiàn yī gè jiù ài yī gè.
examples.english: When dating, you shouldn't be too fickle; in other words, you can't fall in love with every person you meet.

examples.chinese: 人類破壞了自然，就是破壞了自己的生活環境。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi pòhuài le zìrán, jiù shì pòhuài le zìjǐ de shēnghuó huánjìng.
examples.english: When humans destroy nature, they are destroying their own living environment.

examples.chinese: 露營最開心的就是當營火(campfire)燃燒時，大家在營火周圍又唱又跳。
examples.pinyin: Lùyíng zuì kāixīn de jiùshì dāng yínghuǒ ránshāo shí, dàjiā zài yínghuǒ zhōuwéi yòu chàng yòu tiào.
examples.english: The happiest part of camping is when the campfire is burning, everyone sings and dances around the campfire.

examples.chinese: 所謂「人助天助」的意思，就是得自己先努力，天(God,Heavens)才會幫助你。
examples.pinyin: Suǒwèi “rén zhù tiān zhù” de yìsi, jiù shì děi zìjǐ xiān nǔlì, tiān cái huì bāngzhù nǐ.
examples.english: The so-called meaning of 'people help, Heaven helps' is that you must first work hard yourself, and only then will Heaven help you.

examples.chinese: 從小時候起，他的第一志願就是當一位保護國家的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xiǎoshíhou qǐ, tā de dì-yī zhìyuàn jiùshì dāng yī wèi bǎohù guójiā de jūnrén.
examples.english: Since childhood, his first aspiration has been to be a soldier who protects the country.

examples.chinese: 申請留學的過程中，最讓人操心的可能就是寫讀書計畫了。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng liúxué de guòchéng zhōng, zuì ràng rén cāoxīn de kěnéng jiù shì xiě dúshū jìhuà le.
examples.english: In the process of applying to study abroad, what worries people the most is probably writing the study plan.

examples.chinese: 我跟他的個性、想法都合得來，就是飲食習慣合不來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā de gèxìng, xiǎngfǎ dōu hé de lái, jiùshì yǐnshí xíguàn hé bù lái.
examples.english: He and I get along in personality and ideas, but it's just our eating habits that are incompatible.

examples.chinese: 在中國北方，所謂的「大夫」就是醫師，做的是替人醫病的工作。
examples.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó běifāng, suǒwèi de “dàifu” jiùshì yīshī, zuò de shì tì rén yī bìng de gōngzuò.
examples.english: In northern China, the so-called 'dàifu' is a doctor, whose job is to treat people's illnesses.

examples.chinese: 好餐廳的第一條件就是保持乾淨，讓客人有舒適的環境。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo cāntīng de dì yī tiáojiàn jiùshì bǎochí gānjìng, ràng kèrén yǒu shūshì de huánjìng.
examples.english: The first condition for a good restaurant is to keep it clean, so that customers have a comfortable environment.

examples.chinese: 對人民來說，最大的不幸就是國家機構腐敗。
examples.pinyin: Duì rénmín lái shuō, zuìdà de bùxìng jiùshì guójiā jīgòu fǔbài.
examples.english: For the people, the greatest misfortune is corruption in national institutions.

examples.chinese: 華人過春節時有個風俗，就是每戶人家都會在門口貼春聯。
examples.pinyin: Huárén guò Chūnjié shí yǒu ge fēngsú, jiùshì měi hù rénjiā dōu huì zài ménkǒu tiē chūnlián.
examples.english: When Chinese people celebrate Spring Festival, there is a custom: every household will paste spring couplets at the door.

examples.chinese: 她參加這場比賽的唯一目的，就是為了贏得第一名。
examples.pinyin: Tā cānjiā zhè chǎng bǐsài de wéiyī mùdì, jiùshì wèile yíngdé dì yī míng.
examples.english: The sole purpose of her participating in this competition is to win first place.

examples.chinese: 國際棒球比賽快開始了，那一群剛入棒球場、穿藍色運動服的就是臺灣隊。
examples.pinyin: Guójì bàngqiú bǐsài kuài kāishǐ le, nà yì qún gāng jìnrù bàngqiúchǎng, chuān lánsè yùndòngfú de jiùshì Táiwān duì.
examples.english: The international baseball game is about to start; that group that just entered the baseball field wearing blue sportswear is the Taiwan team.

examples.chinese: 解決種族之間因文化差異產生的問題，最好的辦法就是互相尊重。
examples.pinyin: Jiějué zhǒngzú zhījiān yīn wénhuà chāyì chǎnshēng de wèntí, zuì hǎo de bànfǎ jiùshì hùxiāng zūnzhòng.
examples.english: To solve problems that arise between races due to cultural differences, the best approach is mutual respect.

items.wordHook: Combining 就(approach) and 是(be): 就是 means be.

examples.chinese: 小張喜歡閱讀法國的文學作品，透過這些作品，讓他了解了法國文化的特色。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng xǐhuan yuèdú Fǎguó de wénxué zuòpǐn, tòuguò zhèxiē zuòpǐn, ràng tā liǎojiě le Fǎguó wénhuà de tèsè.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang likes to read French literary works; through these works, he has come to understand the characteristics of French culture.

examples.chinese: (1) 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.
examples.english: Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more.

examples.chinese: 他透過古典文學來討論古代與現代的文化差異。
examples.pinyin: Tā tòuguò gǔdiǎn wénxué lái tǎolùn gǔdài yǔ xiàndài de wénhuà chāyì.
examples.english: He discusses the cultural differences between ancient and modern times through classical literature.

examples.chinese: 這次文學比賽，我參加的項目是作文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì wénxué bǐsài, wǒ cānjiā de xiàngmù shì zuòwén.
examples.english: In this literature competition, the event I am participating in is essay writing.

items.wordHook: Combining 文(culture) and 學(learn): 文學 means literature.

examples.chinese: 經理因商品售完而跟顧客道歉，並表示明天就會補上。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yīn shāngpǐn shòu wán ér gēn gùkè dàoqiàn, bìng biǎoshì míngtiān jiù huì bǔ shàng.
examples.english: The manager apologized to the customer because the product was sold out, and indicated that it would be restocked tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我老婆最近又忙又累，因此我特地在餐桌上頭擺了她最愛的紅玫瑰，讓她開心一下。為了打開(to open up)國外市場，公司上頭決定增加網路銷售方面的經費。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lǎopo zuìjìn yòu máng yòu lèi, yīncǐ wǒ tèdì zài cānzhuō shàngtou bǎi le tā zuì ài de hóng méiguī, ràng tā kāixīn yīxià. Wèile dǎkāi guówài shìchǎng, gōngsī shàngtou juédìng zēngjiā wǎnglù xiāoshòu fāngmiàn de jīngfèi.
examples.english: My wife has been both busy and tired recently, so I specially placed her favorite red roses on top of the dining table to cheer her up a bit. In order to open up overseas markets, the company's higher-ups decided to increase funding for online sales.

examples.chinese: 我看見路口有人舉著一面牌子，上面是銷售房屋的廣告。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn lùkǒu yǒu rén jǔ zhe yī miàn páizi, shàngmiàn shì xiāoshòu fángwū de guǎnggào.
examples.english: I saw someone at the intersection holding up a sign, on which was an advertisement for selling houses.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的主題跟銷售新產品有關，所以廣告部門的人員得參加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔtí gēn xiāoshòu xīn chǎnpǐn yǒuguān, suǒyǐ guǎnggào bùmén de rényuán děi cānjiā.
examples.english: The theme of this meeting is related to selling new products, so the personnel from the advertising department must attend.

examples.chinese: 如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。
examples.pinyin: Rú xiǎng tōngguò nà jiā qǐyè de miànshì, jiù děi xiān shúxī tāmen de chǎnpǐn tèsè yǔ xiāoshòu fāngshì.
examples.english: If you want to pass that company's interview, you must first be familiar with their product features and sales methods.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
examples.pinyin: A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 這個保養品很適合皮膚乾的人，所以秋冬兩個季節銷售得非常好。因為店員的服務態度很好，所以這個專櫃的銷售成績是最好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bǎoyǎngpǐn hěn shìhé pífū gān de rén, suǒyǐ qiū dōng liǎng ge jìjié xiāoshòu de fēicháng hǎo. Yīnwèi diànyuán de fúwù tàidù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhège zhuān guì de xiāoshòu chéngjì shì zuì hǎo de.
examples.english: This skincare product is very suitable for people with dry skin, so its sales in the autumn and winter seasons are very good. Because the staff's service attitude is very good, this counter's sales performance is the best.

examples.chinese: 新型筆電銷售時價格通常比較貴，有時倒不如買符合個人需要的舊型筆電。
examples.pinyin: Xīnxíng bǐdiàn xiāoshòu shí jiàgé tōngcháng bǐjiào guì, yǒushí dào bùrú mǎi fúhé gèrén xūyào de jiùxíng bǐdiàn.
examples.english: When new-model laptops are sold, the price is usually relatively expensive; sometimes it would be better to buy an old-model laptop that fits one's personal needs.

examples.chinese: 她到印尼買了一些木頭做的禮品，加工後再到網路上售出。
examples.pinyin: Tā dào Yìnní mǎi le yīxiē mùtou zuò de lǐpǐn, jiāgōng hòu zài dào wǎnglù shàng shòuchū.
examples.english: She went to Indonesia and bought some gifts made of wood; after processing them, she then sold them online.

examples.chinese: 他決定搬到國外去，所以打算出售臺灣的房屋。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédìng bān dào guówài qù, suǒyǐ dǎsuàn chūshòu Táiwān de fángwū.
examples.english: He has decided to move abroad, so he plans to sell his house in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 在觀光景點銷售紀念品，價格通常比一般商店高一些。
examples.pinyin: Zài guānguāng jǐngdiǎn xiāoshòu jìniànpǐn, jiàgé tōngcháng bǐ yībān shāngdiàn gāo yīxiē.
examples.english: Souvenirs sold at tourist attractions are usually a bit more expensive than those in regular stores.

examples.chinese: 這家國際企業因商品銷售情況不理想，決定退出亞洲市場。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā guójì qǐyè yīn shāngpǐn xiāoshòu qíngkuàng bù lǐxiǎng, juédìng tuìchū Yàzhōu shìchǎng.
examples.english: This international enterprise, because product sales were not ideal, decided to withdraw from the Asian market.

items.wordHook: A 隹(bird) above a 口(mouth) is the sale item; the 口(mouth) cries it out → 售(sell).

examples.chinese: 如果想入會員並享受我們健身房所提供的服務，請您到櫃臺辦理。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng rù huìyuán bìng xiǎngshòu wǒmen jiànshēnfáng suǒ tígōng de fúwù, qǐng nín dào guìtái bànlǐ.
examples.english: If you want to become a member and enjoy the services provided by our gym, please go to the counter to handle it.

examples.chinese: 他從音樂學院畢業以後就加入歌劇團，到世界各地表演。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng yīnyuè xuéyuàn bìyè yǐhòu jiù jiārù gējùtuán, dào shìjiè gèdì biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: After graduating from the music conservatory, he joined an opera troupe and performed all over the world.

examples.chinese: 你帶著邀請卡給門口的服務人員檢查，才能入場參加活動。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dài zhe yāoqǐngkǎ gěi ménkǒu de fúwù rényuán jiǎnchá, cái néng rùchǎng cānjiā huódòng.
examples.english: You bring your invitation card for the service staff at the entrance to check, and only then can you enter the venue to participate in the event.

examples.chinese: 我想加入社會服務組織，幫助別人的同時也讓自己成長。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng jiārù shèhuì fúwù zǔzhī, bāngzhù biérén de tóngshí yě ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: I want to join a social service organization; while helping others, I can also let myself grow.

examples.chinese: 圖書館入口那裡寫著不能帶食物進去，你吃完再進去吧。
examples.pinyin: Túshūguǎn rùkǒu nàlǐ xiězhe bù néng dài shíwù jìnqù, nǐ chī wán zài jìnqù ba.
examples.english: At the library entrance, it says you can't bring food in, so finish eating before you go in.

examples.chinese: 顏教授對漢語語法有很深入的研究，難怪他的語法課那麼受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Yán jiàoshòu duì Hànyǔ yǔfǎ yǒu hěn shēnrù de yánjiū, nánguài tā de yǔfǎ kè nàme shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Professor Yan has very profound research on Chinese grammar; no wonder his grammar class is so popular.

examples.chinese: 易先生從職場退休後，就加入了醫院的服務社團，繼續為社會貢獻一份力量。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng cóng zhíchǎng tuìxiū hòu, jiù jiārù le yīyuàn de fúwù shètuán, jìxù wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng.
examples.english: After Mr. Yi retired from the workplace, he joined the hospital's service club and continued to contribute his part to society.

examples.chinese: 透過社群網站，我們可以加入感興趣的社團，讓自己的生活更充實。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, wǒmen kěyǐ jiārù gǎn xìngqù de shètuán, ràng zìjǐ de shēnghuó gèng chōngshí.
examples.english: Through social media, we can join clubs we are interested in, making our lives more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 從我加入這個健身社團後，不但作息正常了，身體也更健康了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiārù zhège jiànshēn shètuán hòu, bùdàn zuòxī zhèngcháng le, shēntǐ yě gèng jiànkāng le.
examples.english: Ever since I joined this fitness club, not only has my daily routine become regular, but my health has also improved.

examples.chinese: 為了旅客搭機安全，機場入境、出境時都要檢查行李。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le lǚkè dā jī ānquán, jīchǎng rùjìng, chūjìng shí dōu yào jiǎnchá xínglǐ.
examples.english: For passenger flight safety, luggage must be checked when entering and leaving the country at the airport.

examples.chinese: 有些國家為了吸引更多的觀光客來旅遊，就把一些出境、入境的手續改簡單了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā wèi le xīyǐn gèng duō de guānguāngkè lái lǚyóu, jiù bǎ yìxiē chūjìng, rùjìng de shǒuxù gǎi jiǎndān le.
examples.english: Some countries, in order to attract more tourists to travel, have simplified some exit and entry procedures.

examples.chinese: 不要僅根據表面來判斷一個人或一件事，得花時間深入瞭解。
examples.pinyin: Bùyào jǐn gēnjù biǎomiàn lái pànduàn yī gè rén huò yī jiàn shì, děi huā shíjiān shēnrù liǎojiě.
examples.english: Don't judge a person or a matter based only on the surface; you must spend time to understand deeply.

examples.chinese: 天天說自己外行、不願嘗試的人，就無法更深入地瞭解世界。
examples.pinyin: Tiāntiān shuō zìjǐ wàiháng, bù yuàn chángshì de rén, jiù wúfǎ gèng shēnrù de liǎojiě shìjiè.
examples.english: People who say they are laymen every day and are unwilling to try cannot understand the world more deeply.

examples.chinese: 就算擁有高收入，也不見得能讓你過著幸福美好的生活。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn yōngyǒu gāo shōurù, yě bújiàndé néng ràng nǐ guòzhe xìngfú měihǎo de shēnghuó.
examples.english: Even if you have a high income, it does not necessarily mean you can live a happy and wonderful life.

examples.chinese: 他想成為網路作家，不過擔心將來的收入可能不穩定。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng chéngwéi wǎnglù zuòjiā, bùguò dānxīn jiānglái de shōurù kěnéng bù wěndìng.
examples.english: He wants to become an online writer, but worries that his future income may be unstable.

examples.chinese: 父母反對她從事電影行業，哪怕收入很高，還是不贊成。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ fǎnduì tā cóngshì diànyǐng hángyè, nǎpà shōurù hěn gāo, háishì bù zànchéng.
examples.english: Her parents oppose her working in the film industry; even if the income is high, they still do not approve.

examples.chinese: 根據醫院規定，進入病房後禁止大聲說話。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù yīyuàn guīdìng, jìnrù bìngfáng hòu jìnzhǐ dàshēng shuōhuà.
examples.english: According to hospital regulations, after entering the ward, speaking loudly is prohibited.

examples.chinese: 看到自己國家的國旗進入奧運會場，民眾也不斷揮著手上的小旗子，替自己的國家加油。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào zìjǐ guójiā de guóqí jìnrù Àoyùn huìchǎng, mínzhòng yě búduàn huī zhe shǒu shàng de xiǎo qízi, tì zìjǐ de guójiā jiāyóu.
examples.english: Seeing their country's national flag enter the Olympic venue, the public also continuously waved the small flags in their hands to cheer for their country.

examples.chinese: 國際棒球比賽快開始了，那一群剛入棒球場、穿藍色運動服的就是臺灣隊。
examples.pinyin: Guójì bàngqiú bǐsài kuài kāishǐ le, nà yì qún gāng jìnrù bàngqiúchǎng, chuān lánsè yùndòngfú de jiùshì Táiwān duì.
examples.english: The international baseball game is about to start; that group that just entered the baseball field wearing blue sportswear is the Taiwan team.

items.wordHook: 入's two strokes slant together at the top and open at the bottom, like legs striding forward to enter → 入(enter).

examples.chinese: 露營時我沒帶枕頭，只好把背包當作枕頭，睡起來挺不舒服的。
examples.pinyin: Lùyíng shí wǒ méi dài zhěntou, zhǐhǎo bǎ bēibāo dàngzuò zhěntou, shuì qǐlái tǐng bù shūfu de.
examples.english: When camping, I didn't bring a pillow, so I had to use my backpack as a pillow; sleeping was quite uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 有人喜歡在枕頭上抹一點兒自己喜歡的香水，聽說可以紓壓。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén xǐhuān zài zhěntou shàng mǒ yīdiǎnr zìjǐ xǐhuān de xiāngshuǐ, tīngshuō kěyǐ shūyā.
examples.english: Some people like to dab a little of their favorite perfume on their pillow; it's said to relieve stress.

examples.chinese: 水和冰基本上是相同的，只是因溫度而產生不同的變化。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ hé bīng jīběnshàng shì xiāngtóng de, zhǐshì yīn wēndù ér chǎnshēng bùtóng de biànhuà.
examples.english: Water and ice are basically the same; they just undergo different changes due to temperature.

items.wordHook: A 圖(picture) on a 片(flat piece) is a 圖片(picture/photo).
Combining 土(soil) and 地(earth): 土地 means land.
On sacred 土(earth), an alert sentry stands watch to 或(guard) every boundary line of the territory → 域(area).
a 宀(roof) covers the 祭(sacrifice) table → the official will 察(examine).
房(house) + 子(noun suffix) → a little house: 房子(house; building).
Stout 木(tree) timbers aligned toward the 東(east) support the roof 棟(pillar).
Flickering fires 火(fire) illuminate a shelter 冖(cover) over pitched 吕(tents) inside the army 營(camp).
Combining 碼(number) and 頭(the first): 碼頭 means pier.
When 米(rice) is served by 曹(officials), the meal turns 糟(bad).
蘋(píng) + 果(fruit) → the fruit called píng: 蘋果(apple).
a 口(gate) says 止(stop) to the tough 艮(mountain) pressing on your 跟(heel).
The 音(sound) stops, and the 儿(person) hears nothing at last: 竟(finally).
a 人(person) takes 良(good) care to set the table → one warm 食(food).
